name: Rain Industries
about: Rain Industries Ltd. is a leading global player in the production of carbon products, cement, and advanced materials. The company’s carbon segment includes calcined petroleum coke, coal tar pitch, and other carbon-based products essential for aluminum, graphite, and titanium dioxide industries. Rain Industries also manufactures high-quality cement and engages in advanced materials production, catering to construction and specialty chemical markets. With a strong presence in India, Europe, and North America, the company operates numerous manufacturing facilities that adhere to international quality standards. Rain Industries focuses on innovation, sustainability, and operational excellence, driving growth and serving diverse industrial needs worldwide.
